planning_policy.quality_rule: Every self-planned wave must reduce a real implementation, correctness, recovery, performance, security, privacy, evidence, integration-readiness or PARITY gap. Filler work is forbidden.
planning_policy.shared_contract_policy: Shared/App remain HQ-owned and epoch-frozen. A Worker records a precise HQ contract request rather than editing them.
planning_policy.integration_policy: HQ performs semantic late integration at useful checkpoints; normal Worker progress does not depend on HQ task release or other lanes completing.

self_planning_priority: current-iPhone PARITY gaps directly owned by the lane
known_gaps in the worker status that can be solved within owned scope
correctness, durability, performance, security and privacy hardening
missing tests, benchmarks and durable evidence
late-integration adapters, measurement hooks and runbooks that can be prepared without editing other lanes
external-gated work: finish all meaningful preparation that does not require the missing credential, rights-cleared fixture, device or human decision

allowed: No meaningful lane-local implementation, hardening or validation preparation remains without an external/human input
A frozen Shared/App contract change is genuinely required
The remaining solution requires editing another lane's owned scope
The operation would be unsafe or technically impossible
forbidden: All old Macro Bundle IDs were consumed
Global Queue has no READY task

lanes.mission: Own the complete lawful source-separation and processing lifecycle surface, including provider/runtime behavior, artifact assurance, failure recovery, evaluation readiness and production hardening.
lanes.worker_instruction: At every next, inspect current branch/status/PARITY and choose the highest-value lane-local wave. External separation credentials or fixtures must not prevent independent processing, validation, security, recovery or evidence-readiness work.

lanes.mission: Own durable media import/export and project/library persistence from app-owned file acquisition through metadata lifecycle, migration, corruption handling, deletion and recovery.
lanes.worker_instruction: Do not wait for iOS shell integration. Continue selecting persistence, IO safety, recovery, scalability, codec-boundary and evidence work that can be completed inside IO/Library.

lanes.mission: Own synchronized multitrack playback and practice DSP semantics, timing safety, control behavior, offline/reference evidence and device-measurement readiness.
current_major_gaps: physical-iPhone timing and audible artifact evidence
rights-cleared real-track and Moises differential evidence
lanes.worker_instruction: Lack of an Apple device is not a reason to stop while portable correctness, deterministic planning, backend safety, offline/reference tooling or measurement preparation can still be improved.

lanes.mission: Own the standalone iOS host/platform surface and music-analysis implementation/evidence while leaving cross-lane semantic integration to HQ.
lanes.worker_instruction: Do not merge other lanes. Continue choosing iOS-host robustness, Analysis correctness, evaluator, vocabulary/unknown semantics, performance preparation and integration-slot work that stays inside owned scope.

responsibilities: merge coherent lane checkpoints when integration has value
resolve Shared/App contract and adapter changes centrally
compile the real integrated iOS target with all lane implementations
late_integration_gate.non_responsibility: HQ does not author or replenish the normal lane-local work backlog.

historical_note: Epoch-2 M01-M04 bundles were the bootstrap mechanism for v3 and remain preserved in Git/worker status history. From planning revision 4 onward they are not the Worker task source.
